zoo:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent city-building game sprite for Shared City 2000. Polished hand-painted miniature architectural illustration, warm stone, natural greens, crisp readable details. STRICT orthographic DIMETRIC 2:1 projection: all ground-aligned straight edges slope exactly +0.5 or -0.5, verticals vertical, no vanishing points. Square lot projects to a diamond exactly twice as wide as deep. Centered complete isolated sprite, genuine transparent background, no shadow outside lot, no text, no labels, no surrounding roads. Ground diamond vertices on a 1024 square canvas: rear (512,416), right (960,640), front (512,864), left (64,640). Keep all ground contents inside this diamond, tall objects may rise above it. No thick floating plinth. Entrances face southwest (bottom left); door thresholds and stair treads parallel to left-to-front edge (+0.5 slope).
Subject: Municipal zoo occupying 4 by 4 game cells. Four readable spacious landscaped animal enclosures with small giraffes, zebras, flamingo pond and a rocky habitat, paths laid out along the two lot axes, modest brick entrance pavilion at southwest, low fences parallel to lot axes, several trees. Keep animal scale small and architecture low so enclosures read clearly. Entire outer lot is one perfect 2:1 diamond.
